basic_info.description: Step into refined luxury with this 4-bed, 3.5-bath, 4,925-sq-ft masterpiece between Pacific Heights and the Presidio. Soaring ceilings and expansive windows bathe every room in natural light and showcase sweeping neighborhood views. The open-concept living and dining areas are ideal for grand entertaining or cozy gatherings, while custom cabinetry, curated lighting, and premium stone surfaces exude timeless elegance. The gourmet chef's kitchen, with top-tier appliances and a generous island, doubles as a culinary dream and social hub. Upstairs, the serene primary suite offers a spa-inspired bath and private retreat. Three versatile bedrooms suit family, guests, or a stylish office. Enjoy tranquil courtyards and easy access to Presidio Golf Course, Fillmore Street boutiques, and top dining. From Lyon Street jogs to Pacific Heights sunset strolls, this address embodies the quintessential San Francisco lifestylea distinctive residence that checks every box for sophisticated city living.
